scope: Integrate existing optional account lifecycle and native transport over production 2.7.7.30. Preserve broader career fields, salary/default ordering, current employer deadlines, source catalog and every published release record.

checks.disclosures: Reviewed website/iPhone persistent storage, native SDK identifiers and security/IP processing, optional consent, explicit provider linking without email-based merge, recent-auth resumable deletion, Apple revocation, private analytics/report-attribution erasure and preservation of shared visibility decisions. Current production salary/deadline/sourcing disclosures retained. No legal certification.
checks.choices: Guest browsing remains available. Deletion is behind its explicit server feature flag and recent-auth confirmation; cloud rule/write barriers and provider configuration are required before activation. No automatic analytics consent or account merging.
checks.security: Owner authorization remains distinct from ordinary providers. Native bridge origin and main-frame checks preserved. No secrets or private QA documents added to the publish allowlist.

openItems: Server credentials, deployed Firestore rules and Firebase provider/linking policy require canonical readback before account lifecycle activation.
Hosted preview, production policy/support readback and Apple server validation/upload are separate pending outcomes.
